content_of_post_to_answer: What mindset has helped you stay positive despite negative people around you?
answer: The mindset that helped me most was separating exposure from absorption. Negative people can influence the atmosphere around you, but they do not have automatic access to your inner world. I stopped asking, “How do I make everyone positive?” and started asking, “What deserves my attention?” The surprising part is that staying positive is less about avoiding negativity and more about refusing to let someone else's perspective become your default lens.
